question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The Lebanese army raided the boat and ______ dozens of water bottles, tuna cans, loaves of bread, boxes of Picon cheese and life jackets.
solution:
The correct answer is 'discovered.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• **Discovered: **find unexpectedly or during a search. (अप्रत्याशित रूप से या खोज के दौरान मिला)
 
• **Learnt: **become aware of (something) by information or from observation. (from somebody/something) (जानकारी या अवलोकन से (कुछ) के बारे में जागरूक बनना)
 
• **Created: **to cause something new to happen or exist. (कुछ नया उत्‍पन्‍न, रचना, बनाना, करना; अस्तित्व में लाना)
 
• **Invented: **to think of or make something for the first time. (कोई बात प्रथम बार सोचना या वस्‍तु प्रथम बार बनाना, किसी बात या वस्‍तु का आविष्‍कार करना)
 
 
 
• The given sentence refers to the unexpected detection of dozens of water bottles, tuna cans, loaves of bread, boxes of Picon cheese and life jackets during a search.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 ​

Correct sentence: *The Lebanese army raided the boat and **discovered**__ dozens of water bottles, tuna cans, loaves of bread, boxes of Picon cheese and life jackets.*
